entities.summary: Luc Marquet is a French volleyball player, who won the silver medal with the Men's National Team at the 2003 European Championships in Berlin, Germany. He earned a total number of 325 caps for the national side. He also competed in the men's tournament at the 1992 Summer Olympics.
